description.value:
You single out a beast you can see within range and bend its instincts to your will. If the beast has an Intelligence of 4 or higher, the power has no effect. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration; the power ends immediately if you or an ally harms the target.

Cast with a slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast for every slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
